description:
List who applied to one of your bounties, best matches first.
Use for: reviewing applicants, or finding every hire including ended ones (status: accepted).
Not for: reading one application with the profile and the bounty terms (get_application); reading what hired workers did (list_hires).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_applications({"bountyId":"b7Kq2mXw9TzR4nLp","status":"pending","limit":20})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

bountyId.description: The bounty id, or a pasted rentahuman.ai/bounties/... link.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

limit.description: Rows wanted. Each call reads one stretch of the applications, for every sort and status, so a page can hold fewer rows than `limit`, or none, while `nextCursor` says more remain; only a page without `nextCursor` is the end.

sort.description: best: matches ranked again each call; pages may repeat or miss rows. newest: stable, newest first. Unreadable records are omitted.

name: list_applications

answer.description: Text, a yes or no, or chosen options. Left out when absent or for file questions; read files with get_application. false means no; [] means no option chosen.

rating.description: Average rating of work. Left out before the first rating ("new"), never 0. Withdrawal notes are not counted.

paidJobs.description: Jobs completed and paid out on RentAHuman, from payment records.

repeatClients.description: Clients who paid this person for two or more jobs.

withdrawalCount.description: Automatic notes for spots this person withdrew from after starting (refunded, not paid). Not ratings and not in rating.

appliedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

fileCount.description: Files sent with the application and its answers. Read them with get_application.

hireId.description: Set once accepted. Use it with the hire tools.

title: List applications
